description: Detects critical priority alerts from Falco runtime security
query:
FalcoLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where priority_s == "Critical"
| extend PodName = output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, Namespace = output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s
| project TimeGenerated, PodName, Namespace, Rule = rule_s, Output = output_s, Priority = priority_s

description: Detects suspicious or unauthorized process execution in containers
query:
FalcoLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where rule_s contains "Process" or rule_s contains "Execution"
| extend PodName = output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, Namespace = output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s, ContainerId = output_fields_container_id_s
| project TimeGenerated, PodName, Namespace, ContainerId, Rule = rule_s, Output = output_s, Priority = priority_s

description: Detects access to sensitive files like /etc/shadow, SSH keys, or credentials
query:
FalcoLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where rule_s contains "Sensitive" or rule_s contains "Secret" or rule_s contains "Credential"
| extend PodName = output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, Namespace = output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s, FileName = output_fields_fd_name_s
| project TimeGenerated, PodName, Namespace, FileName, Rule = rule_s, Output = output_s, Priority = priority_s

FalcoLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where rule_s contains "Shell" or rule_s contains "Reverse" or rule_s contains "Netcat"
| extend PodName = output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, Namespace = output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s
| project TimeGenerated, PodName, Namespace, Rule = rule_s, Output = output_s, Priority = priority_s

displayName: Falco - Multiple Alerts from Same Pod
description: Detects multiple security alerts from the same pod indicating potential compromise
query:
FalcoLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where priority_s in ("Critical", "Error", "Warning")
| extend PodName = output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, Namespace = output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s
| summarize AlertCount = count(), Rules = make_set(rule_s), Priorities = make_set(priority_s) by PodName, Namespace
| where AlertCount >= 5
| project PodName, Namespace, AlertCount, Rules, Priorities
